highlights: Start a workflow from a GitHub issue, comment, pull request or failed check, and let it comment, label or review on GitHub.
A joined server opens much faster: the agents and sidebar from your last visit show at once while the app connects.
On the web, a switch to another server takes about 1 second.
Marketplace has 17 new OpenBot agents, such as QA Tester, PR Shepherd and Chief of Staff.
You can move queued messages in a queue of more than 32 messages.
